gloss: to be connected, to be linked, to be tied to

definitions.gloss: to be connected, to be linked, to be associated
definitions.explanation: For two things to be connected or associated with each other, either physically or conceptually.

examples.japanese: {努力|どりょく}が{成功|せいこう}に{結|むす}び{付|つ}いた。
この{二|ふた}つの{事件|じけん}は{結|むす}び{付|つ}いている。
{研究|けんきゅう}の{成果|せいか}が{新|あたら}しいビジネスに{結|むす}び{付|つ}くことを{期待|きたい}している。
examples.english: We hope the research results will lead to new business opportunities.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pattern: AがBに{結|むす}び{付|つ}く.
Transitive pair: {結|むす}び{付|つ}ける (to connect, to tie together)

WORD FORMATION:
{結|むす}ぶ (to tie) + {付|つ}く (to attach) = to be tied/attached together

KEY PATTERNS:
- Xに{結|むす}び{付|つ}く: to lead to X, to be connected to X
- XとYが{結|むす}び{付|つ}く: X and Y are linked

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {成果|せいか}に{結|むす}び{付|つ}く: to lead to results
- {利益|りえき}に{結|むす}び{付|つ}く: to lead to profit
- {密接|みっせつ}に{結|むす}び{付|つ}いている: to be closely linked
